items.summary: Perform a fresh Internet Computer deployment that produces a new working public URL in the format `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` and record the newly generated URL in-repo as the latest deployment output.

Update `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` to set the **Current Deployment** public URL to the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and keep `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` listed as the previous/deprecated URL.

Update `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` so the 'Your Live Website URL' section includes the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and references the correct sitemap URL for that deployment.

Add documentation for re-attaching the custom ICP0 domain `campus-point-services.icp0.io` so it points to the newly deployed canister (i.e., update the domain mapping/alias to the new canister ID), including a short verification checklist and what to do if the domain still resolves to a deleted/non-existing canister.
